electrics.driver: Adafruit 2448 TB6612 (4 outputs, 15 V): each own-track 0 / 12 V, common track held at 6 V -> +-6 V per motor
electrics.note: stall torque (85 mN m) is 3.5x the gearbox limit (24.5 mN m): limit each motor to ~0.11 A or it strips

park: V-notch on each leg foot + chamfered driver key: key rising into the notch centres the root +-1.5 mm (+-3 deg) -> ripple count only needs +-3 deg
